verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a first-party Container Runtime that runs code on Vercel Functions from an OCI container image built from a Dockerfile or Containerfile at the project root. The page includes a dedicated 'Migrate an existing Docker app' section, and Vercel separately advertises running production workloads in isolated containers and a Container Registry product. Missing for 10: detail on deploying prebuilt images via the Container Registry beyond a nav mention, clarity on how Function duration and memory limits constrain long-running containers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy applications packaged as Docker containers

citations.quote: Run any code and library on Vercel Functions with an OCI container image built from a Dockerfile or Containerfile at the project root.
Run production workloads in isolated containers on Vercel.
